lines.text: Find the area of this shaded shape.
lines.caption: Find the area of this shaded shape.

lines.text: Lots of kids answer forty-eight. But that's NOT quite right!
lines.caption: Lots of kids answer forty-eight. But that's NOT quite right!

lines.text: The rectangle is twelve by eight, and M is the midpoint of the top.
lines.caption: The rectangle is twelve by eight, and M is the midpoint of the top.

lines.text: What is the area of the shaded shape A P M D?
lines.caption: What is the area of the shaded shape A P M D?

lines.text: Here's the trick. Start with a bigger triangle, A C D. It's half the rectangle.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Start with a bigger triangle, A C D. It's half the rectangle.

lines.text: But our shape misses a small corner, triangle P C M.
lines.caption: But our shape misses a small corner, triangle P C M.

lines.text: Similar triangles tell us its height is eight over three. So its area is eight.
lines.caption: Similar triangles tell us its height is eight over three. So its area is eight.

lines.text: Why eight over three? The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
